event.name: Light It Up! 2026
event.tagline: 2nd Annual Tree Lighting · 2° Encendido del Árbol
event.notes: Draft run of show. Times are estimates except where marked Confirmed. Sunset is about 4:55 PM, so the plaza is dark before the lighting.

ongoing.title: Letters to Santa table
ongoing.detail: Kids write a letter and seal it in an envelope. Supplies: paper, envelopes, markers, collection box.

ongoing.title: Background music
ongoing.detail: Holiday playlist between performances. Lower it during host announcements.

ongoing.title: Christmas tree (center of plaza)
ongoing.detail: Stays dark until the lighting cue. Check power and the switch before 4:30 PM.
ongoing.when: Lights on at the lighting cue

cues.title: Gates open · holiday music
cues.notes: Food trucks and vendors open. Letters to Santa table is staffed.

cues.title: Welcome & opening
cues.script: ¡Buenas noches, Little Rock! Welcome to Light It Up at Plaza Frida, our 2nd annual tree lighting. Bienvenidos al segundo Encendido del Árbol...
cues.notes: Thank sponsors. Point people to the Letters to Santa table.

cues.title: Dance performance
cues.script: Please welcome to the stage... EstiloE!

cues.title: Thank-you & intro
cues.script: Give it up for EstiloE! Up next, a voice you're going to love...

cues.title: Music break
cues.notes: Clear and set the space for the horse. Hosts remind families about the Letters to Santa table.

cues.title: Dancing horse performance
cues.script: Everyone please stay behind the line. Here comes something special...
cues.notes: Keep a clear perimeter. Confirm the length and the music cue with the handler.

cues.title: Candles handed out
cues.script: Our volunteers are coming around with candles. Grab one for everyone in your family.

cues.title: Candlelight sing-along
cues.script: Let's raise our candles and sing together...
cues.notes: Song: TBD (e.g. Noche de Paz / Silent Night). Put the lyrics on screen or a printed card.

cues.title: Countdown · LIGHT IT UP!
cues.script: Count down with me! 10, 9, 8... 3, 2, 1... ¡LIGHT IT UP!
cues.notes: The tree AND all the plaza lights come on at "1". Confirm who flips the switch.

cues.title: Santa arrives!
cues.script: Wait... do you hear that? I think someone special saw our lights...

cues.title: Photos with Santa & letter drop-off
cues.notes: Kids hand Santa their letters. Background music continues.

cues.title: Thank you & goodnight
cues.script: Thank you for lighting up Plaza Frida with us! ¡Feliz Navidad!
cues.notes: Thank sponsors, vendors, and performers again.
